purpose: Rank the data that MouldMaster still needs after the 2026-09-09 research expansion. Priority is based on incremental decision value, independence and governability rather than raw source count.
principle: More data is useful only when it adds a new measured context, closes an evidence mechanism, improves exact-grade identity, or supplies first-party validation. Mirrors, versions, simulations and papers from the same experiment do not increase independent evidence count.

priorityQueue.why: This is the main remaining gap between public research evidence and a defensible real-production validation claim.
priorityQueue.currentState: pilot-ready-human-comparison-required; zero authorised external-site validation datasets accepted for the production-validation claim
priorityQueue.acquisitionRoute: owner-authorised controlled transfer or owner-side aggregate profiling under the existing real-pilot contract

priorityQueue.why: External learner datasets can test analytics code but cannot calibrate MouldMaster item difficulty, discrimination or learning gain.
priorityQueue.acquisitionRoute: privacy-safe device/app telemetry after release/approved pilot; never substitute proxy learner data into canonical psychometrics

priorityQueue.gap: Independent blinded engineering judgments on MouldMaster cases
priorityQueue.why: Public labels and papers do not establish whether independent injection-moulding engineers agree with MouldMaster's case reasoning.
priorityQueue.currentState: 20 blinded review packets staged; 0 independent blinded MouldMaster engineer labels
priorityQueue.acquisitionRoute: collect blinded reviews before revealing reference diagnosis/outcome

SKZ LoKI if B2SHARE license is clarified
priorityQueue.why: Would add multi-mould/multi-machine drift, anomaly and bad-shot validation beyond current public families.
priorityQueue.currentState: high-value sources located but private/request-only or license-blank
priorityQueue.acquisitionRoute: written rights clarification or owner-side aggregate profiler

priorityQueue.gap: Recover the already-rights-cleared RWTH PCR raw archive
priorityQueue.why: The CC BY 4.0 rights and experimental value are already strong; retrieval failure is the only major blocker to exact profiling of cavity pressure, control and part mass across virgin/PCR transitions.
priorityQueue.currentState: authoritative record exposes the archive link, but exact archive bytes have not been successfully delivered/profiled in the repository workflow
priorityQueue.acquisitionRoute: publisher-supported download or manual authoritative transfer followed by fingerprint/profile

priorityQueue.gap: Hot-runner actual-state data independent of displayed commands
priorityQueue.why: Current evidence is measured and useful, but a second independent source explicitly comparing command/display to actual hot-runner state would close the mechanism more cleanly.
Water-assisted evidence is now comparatively strong, but the broad assisted-moulding family should not be promoted by treating water, gas and projectile processes as interchangeable.
priorityQueue.currentState: multiple water/fluid-assisted studies verified; gas/projectile evidence still thinner

priorityQueue.gap: Machine/mould maintenance lifecycle data with actual failure events
priorityQueue.why: Current energy/operations datasets capture states and downtime better than component-level failure progression; this limits predictive-maintenance learning.

priorityQueue.gap: Tool wear, cooling-circuit and ejection-force longitudinal data
priorityQueue.why: These mechanisms are operationally important but public datasets rarely link tool condition to shot-level process and quality over time.
priorityQueue.currentState: demoulding mechanism has strong study evidence, but longitudinal production tool-condition datasets remain sparse

priorityQueue.gap: Exact commercial-grade material documents with immutable provenance
priorityQueue.why: These exact grades connect supplier truth to measured experiments and prevent generic polymer values from being treated as grade-specific truth.
priorityQueue.currentState: 7 manufacturer-controlled source candidates staged; 0 new material-grade-v2 records promoted because exact PDS fingerprints/revisions are still incomplete
priorityQueue.acquisitionRoute: download authoritative PDS, SHA-256 fingerprint, record edition/region, map test conditions, preserve supplier-guidance limitations

priorityQueue.why: The measured study strongly supports gate seal and pressure-integral reasoning, but raw cycles would enable direct benchmark/calibration rather than article-level aggregate evidence.
priorityQueue.currentState: publisher-verified article; raw dataset not located

priorityQueue.why: 5,000+ professional mould assemblies could dramatically improve parting/demould/side-action/tooling reasoning, but it is a separate CAD evidence class and licence must be explicit before use.
priorityQueue.currentState: project/repository located; explicit dataset/repository licence not yet captured

subfamilyCaution: fluid-assisted-moulding: water evidence must not automatically promote gas/projectile subfamilies

doNotOptimizeFor: multiple papers from the same experiment
simulation volume counted as measured evidence
metadata sample counts without delivered files
generic polymer property tables in place of exact supplier-grade documents
synthetic/LLM QA counted as learner or engineering validation
boundary: This queue does not authorize collection from private systems, production-control actions, or redistribution of restricted data.
